title: Four weeks after the RBI hike: how fast it's reaching your loan and your FD
short: Four weeks on: how the RBI hike is reaching your loan and FD
dek: Repo-linked loan rates rose the very next day. MCLR loans are only now catching up, and deposit rates are moving bank by bank. Why the same 0.25 point hike travels at different speeds.
card: Repo-linked loan rates rose a day after the hike. MCLR loans moved 10 bps four weeks later. FDs are moving bank by bank.
